clauses.quote: At least one of the grievants involved shall sign and be present at all conferences held.
clauses.subject_text: At least one of the grievants involved

clauses.quote: The Associate Superintendent, Human Resources shall monitor all proceedings
The Associate Superintendent, Human Resources shall be available for procedural advice to all parties.
The Monitor shall receive copies of written grievance(s) and responses at all levels.
An administrator or a grievant may for good cause request an extension of time for a conference, response or an appeal.
Such request shall state the reason for the extension in writing to the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources
clauses.notes: Metonymy; grammatical subject is the request, operative subject is the submitting party.

clauses.quote: who shall grant or deny the request, determine the extension time, and notify all parties of the decision rendered.
clauses.notes: Relative clause functioning as independent duty imposed on the Associate Superintendent.

clauses.quote: The Associate Superintendent's decision shall not be arbitrary or capricious or unreasonable.

The unit member with a grievance shall first present the matter orally to the supervising administrator not later than fifteen (15) duty days following the occurrence which prompted the grievance or within fifteen (15) duty days of the time when the grievant would reasonably be expected to know that he/she has been adversely affected.
clauses.subject_text: The unit member with a grievance

clauses.quote: Upon request, an additional ten (10) days may be granted by the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources.
The grievant shall state that this is an "oral grievance," citing the Article and section number of the Agreement that allegedly has been violated.

the grievant may reduce the grievance to writing on the approved District form and present the completed form to the immediate supervising administrator within ten (10) duty days following the oral conference or oral response.
clauses.notes: Extracted from conditional sentence structure; grants worker discretion to escalate.

clauses.quote: The grievance shall set forth specifically the item contained within this Agreement upon which the grievance is based.
clauses.notes: Metonymy; operative duty falls on the grievant preparing the document.

clauses.quote: It shall also contain the adverse effect on the grievant and suggested solution(s).
clauses.notes: Refers to the written grievance form; duty falls on the grievant.
